recordScope: Historical same-host migration benchmark; later exact-current operation and Ubuntu-native package evidence are recorded separately.

runtime.method: Pre-extracted final AppImage AppDir; one unrecorded prime; per-run isolated HOME and XDG directories with fixture settings and Steam metadata; native-ready log marker; initial get_state completion marker; aggregate process-tree PSS/RSS after two idle seconds; three 30-second CPU samples; native WM_DELETE_WINDOW shutdown

fixtureOperations.method: Optimized in-process Rust against the same synthetic BO3 directory, representative config/T7/DXVK markers, Steam metadata, deterministic non-sparse 256 MiB executable, and deterministic 4 MiB Deflate ZIP/tar.gz archives

build.method: Serialized monotonic wall-clock elapsed time; warm commands follow one unrecorded normalization build; clean Rust runs use an emptied isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR while retaining downloaded dependency/system caches; clean full AppImage is one empty-target build completed with the pinned offline runtime after restricted-network linuxdeploy produced the final AppDir

packageValidation.appImageBuild: passed; final AppDir completed by Tauri and was packaged with the already-verified x86_64 runtime because network access is restricted
packageValidation.appImageGuiSmoke: passed; packaged AppImage reached the interactive marker and closed through WM_DELETE_WINDOW
packageValidation.appImageRepackReproducibility: passed; two serial packages of the same AppDir under the source epoch were byte-identical
packageValidation.rawDebBuild: passed; Tauri artifact structurally inspected, canonical Debian repack and lifecycle require Ubuntu/dpkg-deb
packageValidation.msiUpgradeSmokeConfigured: hash-pinned beta3 Electron MSI -> current Tauri MSI upgrade, single product registration, installed native-window launch, and clean shutdown before artifact upload; not executed locally
packageValidation.releaseWorkflowValidation: YAML, embedded shell/Node, action pins, immutable tags, six-asset/sidecar validation, draft reruns, published no-op, trusted metadata, and secret boundaries passed local static/mocked review
packageValidation.msiBuildOnLinuxHost: not supported by Tauri; requires Windows

limitations: No /dev/fuse was available, so both baseline and final runtime measurements use pre-extracted AppImages.
Payload-cold runs use POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED and are not equivalent to a reboot or privileged whole-system cache drop.

Long-running host/WebKit state has two observed timing and proportional-memory regimes. This final refresh landed in the same approximately 0.92-second/320-MiB-PSS regime retained in optimization-measurements.json; every sample, including one 1.415-second warm outlier, is preserved.
The Windows MSVC target check and release link passed locally with cargo-xwin, producing a PE32+ GUI executable; Tauri and WiX still require windows-latest CI to author and exercise the actual MSI.
The local host lacks dpkg-deb, so the raw Tauri Debian artifact is recorded locally while deterministic canonicalization and install/upgrade/launch/purge testing remain Ubuntu CI gates.
The restricted shell blocked linuxdeploy's runtime download; the final AppDir was packaged offline with the already-hash-verified AppImage runtime. Repacking that fixed AppDir was reproducible.
Network-backed install and update timings are intentionally excluded because remote service variability would make the comparison irreproducible.
Install/uninstall CPU and wall-time were not compared because the implementations have different transaction and network boundaries.
The baseline full state refresh and final component-status benchmark do not have identical semantics, so no percentage is claimed for that row.
Sub-millisecond detection and config measurements are sensitive to timer and filesystem noise; the recorded medians use the fixed repeated workload.
Clean builds retain downloaded Cargo registry artifacts, installed system libraries, and cached packaging tools.

The local custom-sysroot AppImage used NO_STRIP=1 for system libraries; Rust symbol stripping remained enabled by the selected release profile. Hosted Ubuntu and Arch package smokes and a physical Steam Deck remain external gates.
